options: (d) AgNO3 solution and copper metal. Copper is more reactive than silver and displaces it.

Give reasons why Aluminium is used for cooking utensils despite high reactivity.
options: Aluminium reacts with oxygen to form a thin, strong, non-porous protective oxide layer (Al2O3) that prevents further cor
explanation: Aluminium reacts with oxygen to form a thin, strong, non-porous protective oxide layer (Al2O3) that prevents further corrosion. It is also light and a good conductor of heat.

Describe the electrolytic refining of crude copper with diagram setup details.
options: Anode: Impure crude copper block. Cathode: Thin sheet of pure copper. Electrolyte: Acidified CuSO4 solution. On passing
explanation: Anode: Impure crude copper block. Cathode: Thin sheet of pure copper. Electrolyte: Acidified CuSO4 solution. On passing current, pure Cu dissolves from anode and deposits at cathode (Cu2+ + 2e- -> Cu). Insoluble impurities settle at bottom as anode mud.
